title: Fire vs Earth in a job interview
caption:
Two great candidates, two completely different strategies.

Fire prepped for an hour, answers in 60 seconds and sends the thank-you email from the lift. Earth prepped for a week, has eleven numbered questions and sends a perfect email the next morning. Both can win.

The useful bit is on slide 6. Send this to a friend with an interview this week.
